title: San Util Design’s Updated Whirlpool MkII
content:
The San Util Design Whirlpool MkII is an updated version of their classic hip pack, a utilitarian gear-hauler. The MkII refresh gets more pockets, more organization, and more whirlpool. But don’t worry, the simpler “classic” design is still on offer. You don’t have to have the fancy stuff unless you really want it.

The Whirlpool MkII is an evolution of San Util’s classic gear-hauling hip pack. The Whirlpool MkII builds on the design elements that made the original Whirlpool so good. The classic version was a simple bag that carries weight well, can be overstuffed, and is perfect for a bladder. The MkII adds some big zippered pockets on the wings, a dedicated phone pocket on the back, and more internal organization.

If you wanted more swirl to your whirlpool, this answers your desires.

San Util Whirlpool MkII Design Overview

San Util uses a 420D face fabric laminated with an X-ply and 70D internal layer. A 200D Oxford Packcloth makes it easy to see inside the bag and adds more abrasion resistance. All the buckles are high-quality Woojin, Duraflex, and Fidlock buckles for quick access and durability.

If you are a fan of the classic Whirlpool, don’t worry, it’s not going anywhere. You’ll find it in the San Util catalog, solidified in its place with a “classic” moniker. The classic and updated versions share these fundamental features:

  • Designed around a 1.5L lumbar bladder (sold separately)
  • Works with our bottle holsters for more water carrying capacity
  • Utility daisy chain for lashing extra gear
  • Compression straps on bottom for rain jacket or knee pads
  • Roll-top and expandable
  • Visible orange liner fabric

Whirlpool MkII Updates

  • Slightly larger volume (roughly 4L – 6L)
  • Large wing zipper pockets w/ key loop
  • Spine column on back for added stability
  • Same floating wing design as the “classic” (we are still selling our original Whirlpool and calling it the Classic)
  • Internal zipper pocket, drop pockets and bladder sleeve
  • External phone pocket for easy access
  • Fabric: 420D laminated sailcloth with a 70D backer
  • Liner: 200D Oxford Pack Cloth
  • Buckles: Woojin, Duraflex, Fidlock
  • Weight: 471g
  • Cost: $135

See the Whirlpool MkII and more at San Util.
